title: Battery pack cell temperature spread out of range
text: A large cell temperature spread usually points to uneven cooling across the pack or a cell group with rising internal resistance. Recommended action: reduce load via throttle_load or eco_mode to cut heat generation, verify coolant flow to the affected pack zone, and if the spread does not settle after cooling, schedule a pack inspection - persistent spread accelerates SOH loss.

title: Battery state of health below service threshold
text: Low SOH reflects cumulative capacity fade from charge cycling and elevated operating temperature, not a transient fault - throttling will not restore it. Recommended action: schedule_service for a pack health inspection and consider reducing fast-charge frequency and average operating temperature to slow further degradation.

title: State of charge critically low
text: Low SOC risks an unplanned shutdown or reduced power availability. Recommended action: eco_mode to extend remaining range and route to charging at the earliest opportunity; this is an operational condition, not a hardware fault.

title: Motor winding temperature exceeds safe limit
text: Sustained high motor temperature risks winding insulation damage and accelerated bearing wear. Recommended action: throttle_load immediately to reduce torque demand and heat generation; if temperature does not fall within a few minutes, restart_subsystem to reset the drive electronics, and escalate to service if it recurs.

title: Inverter temperature exceeds safe limit
text: Elevated inverter temperature typically triggers power derating to protect the power electronics. Recommended action: eco_mode or throttle_load to reduce switching losses, verify inverter coolant loop flow, and restart_subsystem if the derating logic appears stuck.

title: Coolant temperature above target (EV thermal loop)
text: Coolant running hot suggests reduced pump duty cycle or a partially blocked radiator path. Recommended action: restart_subsystem to reset the thermal management controller and force a pump duty-cycle recalibration; schedule_service if elevated coolant temperature persists across resets.

title: Charge rate exceeds expected ceiling
text: An unexpectedly high negotiated charge rate can stress the pack and connector. Recommended action: verify charger handshake/negotiation; restart_subsystem on the onboard charger controller if the rate does not settle to the expected profile.

title: Oil pressure low or oil temperature high
text: Low oil pressure or overheated oil both accelerate bearing and cylinder wall wear if sustained. Recommended action: throttle_load to reduce engine load and heat generation immediately; this is a mechanical wear risk, so schedule_service for an oil system inspection is strongly recommended even if telemetry recovers.

title: Engine coolant temperature exceeds safe limit
text: Overheating coolant risks head gasket damage if sustained. Recommended action: throttle_load or eco_mode to reduce combustion heat immediately, and restart_subsystem to reset the cooling fan/thermostat controller; schedule_service if the temperature does not recover after a reset.

title: Vibration index above baseline
text: Elevated vibration is a proxy for mount, bearing, or balance wear rather than a condition that clears with a mode switch. Recommended action: throttle_load to reduce mechanical stress in the short term, but schedule_service for a mechanical inspection - vibration trending upward over time typically indicates a wear-out failure mode.

title: Misfires or air-fuel ratio deviation detected
text: Misfires or an off-target air-fuel ratio point to ignition or fuel-delivery issues. Recommended action: restart_subsystem to reset the engine control unit's fuel trims; if misfires continue, schedule_service for ignition/fuel system diagnostics rather than repeatedly resetting.

title: Multivariate telemetry outlier (no single threshold breached)
text: This reading was flagged as an outlier relative to the asset's own recent history even though no single fault-library threshold was crossed - often an early combination of small deviations across several signals. Recommended action: throttle_load as a conservative first step and monitor closely; schedule_service if the anomaly recurs across multiple readings.
